result.method: One saved original-forward source; actual captured module-boundary vectors. CPU float64 summaries, norms, differences and cosines; native float32 saved-operand reconciliation at atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4. Signed delta is after-minus-before, a derived difference, while attention and MLP updates are directly captured. Relative L2 audit uses the existing declared 1e-12 reference-norm floor. No model calls. Magnitude, geometry and coordinate ranks are descriptive, not causal importance or evidence of named concepts.
result.ranking_policy: absolute: descending |value|; positive: positive values descending; negative: negative values ascending; exact ties use ascending original coordinate. At most top_k rows; sign-filtered tables can be empty.
